newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse wins $40 million nuclear contract.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse wins $40 million nuclear contract.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp. said Monday it has won a $40 million contract from FPL Group Inc.'s Forida Power & Light Co. to provide nuclear fuel and fuel-related services at two nuclear power plants.
The contract, said Westinghouse, covers four fuel reloads per unit and will run at least through 2003.
The Westinghouse Commercial Nuclear Fuel Division is part of its Energy Systems Business Unit, which provides products and services to the worldwide commercial nuclear power industry.
Westinghouse's stock fell 37.5 cents to $23.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
